```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

```{r readHistory}
history <- utils::read.delim(
  system.file("extdata", "score_history.tsv", package = "prolfquabenchmark", mustWork = TRUE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  colClasses = c(prolfqua_version = "character", date = "character", tool_version = "character", level = "character")
)
datasets <- utils::read.delim(
  system.file("extdata", "benchmark_datasets.tsv", package = "prolfquabenchmark", mustWork = TRUE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
history_url <- "https://github.com/prolfqua/prolfquabenchmark/blob/main/inst/extdata/score_history.tsv"
releases <- as.character(sort(unique(package_version(history$prolfqua_version))))
# models removed from prolfqua have no rows at the latest release and are not shown; score_history.tsv keeps them
history <- history[history$method %in% history$method[history$prolfqua_version == dplyr::last(releases)], ]
history$prolfqua_version <- factor(history$prolfqua_version, levels = releases)
release_dates <- history |>
  dplyr::summarise(date = max(date), .by = "prolfqua_version") |>
  dplyr::arrange(prolfqua_version)
# MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 (also msqrob2's hurdle model): only their current performance is shown
history$external <- grepl("^(MSstats|msqrob2|proDA)", history$method)

# HTML table that scrolls sideways when it has many columns
wide_table <- function(table, caption, digits) {
  html <- knitr::kable(
    table,
    format = "html",
    digits = digits,
    format.args = list(nsmall = digits),
    caption = caption,
    escape = FALSE,
    table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\""
  )
  cat("\n<div style=\"overflow-x: auto;\">\n", html, "\n</div>\n\n", sep = "")
}

release_plot <- function(data, y) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = prolfqua_version, y = value, colour = method, shape = method, group = method)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "prolfqua release", y = y) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()
}

# Prints a plot from inside a results = "asis" loop, in order with the text, with its own height and caption
print_with_height <- function(plot, height, caption) {
  header <- paste0(
    "```{r, fig.height = ", height, ", fig.cap = ", paste(deparse(caption, width.cutoff = 500L), collapse = ""), "}"
  )
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = c(header, "print(plot)", "```"), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE))
}
```

`make score-history` runs the benchmark pipeline (`workflow/Snakefile`) with the installed prolfqua and appends its scores and step timings to [`inst/extdata/score_history.tsv`](`r history_url`), one block of rows per prolfqua release. This page shows the partial AUC pAUC_10 per release; the file holds every score (AUC, pAUC_10, pAUC_20, AP, pAP_50, pAP_80), per contrast and for all contrasts pooled. The current results with ROC curves are in the vignette `Benchmark_results`.

- Releases: `r paste0(release_dates$prolfqua_version, " (", release_dates$date, ")", collapse = ", ")`
- pAUC_10: partial area under the ROC curve up to a false positive rate of 0.1, on a 0 to 100 scale, all contrasts of a dataset pooled; ranking by fold change (`log_fc`), by p-value signed by the fold change (`scaled.p_value`) and by t statistic (`t_statistic`)
- Encoding: colour is the model family of the [prolfqua factory figure](https://github.com/fgcz/prolfqua#readme), point shape the model within its family; MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 are dark grey with open shapes. A model looks the same here and in `Benchmark_results`
- `tool_version` in the data: the software that fitted the model; MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 carry their own version, so their scores change with their releases, not with prolfqua's
- History starts with prolfqua 1.9.0 (commit `f4dfb7f3`, 2026-11-02, before the rOpenSci self-review), rerun with the pipeline (`make score-history-release V=1.9.0 PROLFQUA=f4dfb7f3 PROLFQUAPP=18914707`); each tagged release adds a block: install it, then `make score-history`

# pAUC_10 across releases

One figure and one table per dataset; the numbers of every release are in [`score_history.tsv`](`r history_url`). Lines join the releases of a prolfqua model; a model has no point at a release without its facade (`prolfqua_ropecaV2_nested` came with prolfqua 1.9.4); models removed from prolfqua are not shown, their rows stay in `score_history.tsv`. MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 are shown at their latest recorded run only.

```{r pauc, results = "asis"}
pauc <- history |>
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "all", metric == "pAUC_10") |>
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method) |>
  dplyr::filter(!external | as.integer(prolfqua_version) == max(as.integer(prolfqua_version))) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(model = dplyr::case_when(
    !external ~ method,
    startsWith(tool_version, paste0(method, " ")) ~ tool_version,
    .default = paste0(method, " (", tool_version, ")")
  ))
for (dataset_name in sort(unique(pauc$dataset))) {
  cat("\n\n## ", dataset_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  scores <- dplyr::filter(pauc, dataset == dataset_name)
  positive <- datasets$positive[datasets$dataset == dataset_name]
  negative <- datasets$negative[datasets$dataset == dataset_name]
  print_with_height(
    release_plot(scores, "pAUC_10, all contrasts pooled") +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~score) +
      prolfquabenchmark::method_scales(scores$method),
    height = 5,
    caption = paste0(
      "pAUC_10 on ", dataset_name, " per prolfqua release: partial area under the ROC curve up to a false ",
      "positive rate of 0.1 (0 to 100), all contrasts pooled, separating ", positive, " proteins (changed) from ",
      negative, " proteins (unchanged). Panels rank proteins by fold change (log_fc), by p-value signed by the ",
      "fold change (scaled.p_value) and by t statistic. Lines join the releases of a prolfqua model. Colour: model ",
      "family as in the prolfqua factory figure; shape: model within its family; grey open shapes: MSstats, proDA ",
      "and msqrob2 at their latest recorded run."
    )
  )
  latest <- scores |>
    dplyr::arrange(prolfqua_version) |>
    dplyr::mutate(change = round(value - dplyr::lag(value), 1), .by = c("method", "score")) |>
    dplyr::filter(prolfqua_version == dplyr::last(prolfqua_version), .by = "method")
  ranked <- latest |>
    dplyr::filter(score == "scaled.p_value") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(value))
  latest |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(change) | change == 0,
      sprintf("%.1f", value),
      sprintf("%.1f (%+.1f)", value, change)
    )) |>
    dplyr::select(model, release = prolfqua_version, score, value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "score", values_from = "value") |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(model, ranked$model)) |>
    dplyr::select(model, release, dplyr::any_of(c("log_fc", "scaled.p_value", "t_statistic"))) |>
    wide_table(
      caption = paste0(
        "pAUC_10 on ", dataset_name, " at the latest release of each model, all contrasts pooled, for ranking by ",
        "fold change, scaled p-value and t statistic; sorted by scaled p-value. In parentheses: change from the ",
        "model's previous recorded release, where there is one. MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 labelled with their ",
        "version. All scores, also per contrast: <a href=\"", history_url, "\">score_history.tsv</a>."
      ),
      digits = 1
    )
}
```

# Timings

Median elapsed seconds over 3 repetitions, IonStar MaxQuant peptides, all proteins with at least 2 peptides. Timings compare only within one machine: `r paste(unique(history$tool_version[history$metric == "elapsed_s"]), collapse = ", ")`.

```{r timingsFacades, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Elapsed seconds of build_contrast_analysis() per prolfqua release, fit and contrasts, for the methods lm, limma, lm_impute and rlm (rows facade_lm, facade_limma, facade_lm_impute and facade_rlm of score_history.tsv), median of 3 runs on the IonStar MaxQuant peptides. Colour and shape as in the pAUC_10 figures."}
facade_timings <- history |>
  dplyr::filter(metric == "elapsed_s", startsWith(method, "facade_")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(method = sub("^facade_", "prolfqua_", method))
release_plot(facade_timings, "elapsed seconds (median of 3)") +
  prolfquabenchmark::method_scales(facade_timings$method)
```

```{r timingsSteps, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Elapsed seconds of the core prolfqua steps per release, median of 3 runs on the IonStar MaxQuant peptides. transform: log2 and robust scaling on the human proteins; aggregate: median polish to proteins; fit_lm: one lm per protein; contrasts_lm: Wald contrasts with variance moderation."}
release_plot(dplyr::filter(history, metric == "elapsed_s", !startsWith(method, "facade_")), "elapsed seconds (median of 3)")
```

```{r timings, results = "asis"}
history |>
  dplyr::filter(metric == "elapsed_s") |>
  dplyr::select(release = prolfqua_version, method, value) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "method", values_from = "value", names_sort = TRUE) |>
  tidyr::complete(release) |>
  dplyr::arrange(release) |>
  wide_table(caption = "Elapsed seconds per step and release.", digits = 2)
```
